changelog:
🎉 What's New in FlixQuest v4.2.0

✨ New
- Redesigned mobile app with a new home feed, Top 10 and Discover tab
- My FlixQuest hub, Continue Watching and Up Next
- Credits pages, plus cast and guest stars on episodes
- Insights dashboard for your viewing habits
- Live TV links (flix.quest/l/…) now jump straight to the channel
- Player quality settings and a new playback loading screen

📺 Android TV
- Rebuilt D-pad navigation, so focus no longer jumps around
- Back button now behaves correctly, including on Android 16
- Redesigned details pages and a light theme
- Skeleton loaders instead of spinners

🎬 Player
- Reworked player with a better subtitle picker
- Faster source loading

🔧 Other
- Bandwidth tracking
- Many layout fixes and improvements
